runs.what: the dry run (Claude Haiku 5.5 as the player)
CW-opus, first attempt — lost when the cloud container restarted during the owner's pause at its first combat card (t6); estimate
runs.estimate: The app's own cost log for the attempt (docs/runs/game-player-combat-1-lost-attempt.jsonl: the wizard, the prep, 5½ DM turns) sums to $3.23; the player's six calls and the welfare checks were metered in memory and lost with the process (about $0.3 at list prices); booked at $4.50 to stay on the safe side of the cap. The shared OpenRouter account cannot separate it (other sessions spent on the same key in the same hour).
